cm_shortcode_hint: Add this shortcode to your theme's template (e.g. content-articles.php) to show it on every item, or paste it directly into an individual article/page/project's content:
cm_search_placeholder: Search by author, email, content, or slug…
cm_mode_manual_hint: Every comment stays hidden until you approve it.
cm_mode_auto_hint: Comments appear immediately. You can still moderate them afterward.
cm_settings_types_hint: Comments only appear where your theme includes the [comments] shortcode in its template — this only controls which content types allow it.
cm_settings_blacklist_hint: One word or phrase per line. A comment containing any of these is silently held for moderation instead of being rejected outright.
cm_settings_hcaptcha_missing: Configure your hCaptcha site key and secret key under Settings → Contact first — the comment form reuses that same configuration.
cm_settings_hcaptcha_enable: Require hCaptcha on the comment form
cm_settings_dashboard_widget: Show pending comments widget on the dashboard
